scope: Only the native network review output-token budget; no network API or contract runtime change.

change.paymentValidation: Only the trusted native review handler extends the 8192 default to 16384; original request body remains intact. All other validation is reused unchanged.

checks.scope: Two targeted tests and a typecheck ran in the full private agent/payment worktree; mirrors are not standalone runtime distributions.

deploymentOrder: Promote and verify the payment relay accepting native review requests through 16384 tokens.
Then promote the matching agent; the release procedure requires the verified live payment deployment.
rollbackOrder: Only then restore the older payment validator.
telemetryBoundary: The legacy effectiveMaxOutputTokens field records the sent request, not independently verified provider adaptation. A complete genuine verdict and its actual usage are separate evidence.
